scope: source/profile audit; no benchmark and no policy labels certified for execution

policy_inputs.columns: 1:54 (53 measured/manipulated variables; original order, constants retained)
policy_inputs.excluded: column 0 Time; all simulator attrs/profiles, economic_data and path-derived IDs
policy_inputs.additional_meas: not used; variable row alignment not assumed

profile_axes.evidence: third row 30 on changed SP/IDV columns; not named by dataset attrs or README. Do not treat inference as certified label.
profile_axes.source_verification_needed: dataset-specific paper/method or generator definition; linked 2015 simulator is modified and cannot alone certify the 2021 row contract

normal_a.requires: verified initial-mode normal operation, no active faults, source-defined warmup cut

transition.semantics: commanded mode/setpoint ramp with no programmed IDV in inspected completed cases; globally nominal/healthy transition guarantee unverified
transition.policy_action: WAIT is a proposed conservative protocol, not a source action label

normal_b.endpoint_rule: ramp command end is not a verified settling end; never use detector score or CV to create endpoint

fault.interval: [verified activation, observed stream end + dt), right-censored
fault.status: fault presence/family verified by path + profile; activation row semantics pending
fault.ramp_attr_warning: fault runs tRampSetpoint=1 does not establish a fault onset ramp or settling time

forced_shutdown.handling: exclude from benign PROMOTE-safe and primary normal-starvation intervals; keep separately as SHUTDOWN_CENSORED; no fabricated observations after shutdown

warmup.handling: do not invent cutoff, fit scaler or label initial prefix normal before verification

default_evaluator_state: UNKNOWN until axes and warmup verified; stopped runs remain UNKNOWN in guarded implementation
source_health_guarantee: completed normally means simulation completed, not evidence of healthy settled operation
